# Geekedu

> > Geekedu is a STEM education platform offering 1-on-1 online coding and math classes for ages 7-18, with specialized curricula in Python, Java, Roblox, and advanced mathematics.

Geekedu provides personalized computer science and mathematics instruction through live online classes, summer camps, and structured learning paths. The platform serves students from beginners to advanced learners preparing for AP exams and programming competitions.

## Key Topics

- 1-on-1 online tutoring
- Coding for kids
- Python programming
- Computer science education
- Mathematics education
- Game development
- Roblox Studio
- Java and AP Computer Science
- Competition preparation (AMC, Euclid)
- AP Calculus
- Summer camps
- Project-based learning
- Beginner-friendly curriculum
- Online learning platform
- STEM education

## Core Platform

- [Geekedu - Coding for kids | Math for kids | Coding program for kids](https://www.geekedu.org): Geekedu homepage: STEM education platform offering 1-on-1 coding and math for ages 7-18
- [About Us | Learn Computer Science and Mathematics](https://www.geekedu.org/about-us): Geekedu's mission, company background, and educational approach to CS and math
- [Our Instructor | Geekedu](https://www.geekedu.org/review): Instructor profiles and parent/student testimonials for Geekedu's 1-on-1 classes

## Learning Curricula

- [Geekedu | Computer Science Curriculum | Coding Class for Kids | 1-on-1 Coding Class](https://www.geekedu.org/paths/computer-science): Computer science curriculum covering Scratch, Python, Java, Roblox, and contest prep
- [Geekedu | Math Courses for Middle School Students | Math Tutors for High School Students](https://www.geekedu.org/paths/mathematics): Math curriculum from pre-algebra to calculus with competition prep for AMC and Euclid

## Coding Courses

- [Python Level 1 | Online Classes for Kids |Geekedu](https://www.geekedu.org/course/python-level-1): Beginner Python course using Turtle graphics and PyGame for project-based learning
- [Python Level 3 | Online Classes for Kids |Geekedu](https://www.geekedu.org/course/python-level-3): Advanced Python course with Tkinter, web scraping, AI/ML, and portfolio projects
- [AP Computer Science A | Online Classes for Kids |Geekedu](https://www.geekedu.org/course/advanced-placement-computer-science-a): AP Computer Science A exam prep course covering Java and ArrayLists
- [Roblox Coding Classes & Camp | Online Sessions | Geekedu](https://www.geekedu.org/roblox-class): Roblox game development classes using Lua and Roblox Studio for kids and teens

## Mathematics Courses

- [Calculus | Online Classes for Kids |Geekedu](https://www.geekedu.org/course/calculus): Comprehensive single-variable calculus course preparing students for AP Calculus
- [Introduction to Geometry | Online Classes for Kids |Geekedu](https://www.geekedu.org/course/introduction-to-geometry): Geometry course for grades 6-10 covering trigonometry and 3D geometry concepts

## Programs & Pricing

- [Online Coding Summer Camp for kids & Teens | Geekedu](https://www.geekedu.org/summer): Summer camp programs for ages 7-19 featuring coding, game design, and math
- [Geekedu | Tuition Plans and What We Offering- Course for Kids](https://www.geekedu.org/tuition): Pricing and subscription plans for Geekedu's 1-on-1 private online classes

## Blog & Tutorials

- [Geekedu |  Blog | Resources and Learning Tools](https://www.geekedu.org/blog): Blog hub featuring coding tutorials, math guides, and educational resources for kids

- [A Comprehensive Guide On How To Improve Coding Skills](https://www.geekedu.org/blogs/a-comprehensive-guide-on-how-to-improve-coding-skills): Comprehensive guide for improving coding skills and career development
- [Python Web Scraper for beginner](https://www.geekedu.org/blogs/python-web-scraper-for-beginner): Beginner Python tutorial on web scraping with BeautifulSoup and HTML parsing
- [Python Mother's Day Greeting Card](https://www.geekedu.org/blogs/python-mothers-day-greeting-card): Beginner Python Turtle graphics tutorial for creating Mother's Day greeting cards
